title: App shell: TanStack Start; the Barkpark token lives only in server functions
evidence: app/src/server/barkpark.ts (server-only; token from .env or the owner's bp login); app/src/chat/api.ts loadChat/startChat/sendMessage; /api/chat/$id/events passes Barkpark's stream through. Browser bundle has no token code (build checked). A real turn ran end to end through the app on 2026-11-11 (T6). Only BarkBot's own conversations open (task-26a1a137b955ef3b): the token can open any session id, so every door that takes one (the two /api/chat/$id routes and sendMessage, uploadAttachment, answerApproval, answerQuestion) first asks app/src/server/own-session.ts ownSession: a registered-host session on one of the caller's own computers that a bot record names or this server made (startChat). Anything else, or a read that fails, is a 404 with no bytes, or nothing sent (scripts/lib/own-session.mjs: 6 rules). When no bot record could be saved (the Main Bot's move-in failed or waits), loadChat opens no conversation: one picked then would be in no record, so its doors would refuse it; the next message starts one (startChat), which opens. Known misses, accepted: after a restart, a conversation whose bot record was not saved (kept: false) does not open until its record is saved; a conversation on a revoked computer does not open (Barkpark's list leaves revoked computers out); the move-in adopts the newest folderless conversation on our computer, which can be a workspace-mate's, and once saved in the Main Bot's record it is trusted (task-7baccaa5734a64bd, needs task-7efaf895e8bc88e4). Barkpark does not record who made a session; task-7efaf895e8bc88e4 would.
gate: vite build fails if browser code imports server/barkpark (vite.config.ts); npm run turn:live (owner-run: needs the owner's Barkpark login and the enrolled Mac online; not in land or CI). Record: parity/live/turn.json. Seen to fail both ways on 2026-11-11: no computer by that name, and the host stopped (no reply in 90 s). npm run check 'own session': every door that takes a session id, read from the source (scripts/lib/session-doors.mjs), asks ownSession before it uses it.
